pages.text: The crust. Pearly, blast-proof and harder than obsidian. Only a $(l:basics/crustbreaker)Crustbreaker$(/l) can mine it.
pages.title: Shellrock

pages.text: The main stone inside, made of fossil shell plates. Polish it, brick it or carve pillars from it (stonecutter or crafting). Stairs, slabs and walls too.
pages.title: Chitinstone

pages.text: Soft glowing soil-stone. Alien plants and saplings only grow on Glowmarl, so take some home if you want a meteor garden.
pages.title: Glowmarl
